name: knowledge
description: Explain a topic, a code change or a general subject as a native chapter — Markdown with typed blocks for diagrams, figures, callouts and a quiz, plus a cited best-practices section — in your own knowledge base. It runs as an explain phase in a workflow workspace (v86 or later): one confirmation, then research, write, check and a private publish. One setup skill connects the hosted KB or scaffolds your own.
